official: The adopted Part B entered into force on 1 September 2026. The cover, official index and adoption clause control despite an old footer. Articles 4.1 and 5.1 and the dated catalogue agree on 60 EC each year. The ordinary illustration uses 10 EC Greek proficiency and 10 EC Latin proficiency, with each transition module replacing its same-language assessment for a student without the relevant school exam. It excludes the old Academic Skills and Highlights units shown in a separate catalogue group, and counts the thesis once. The second-year 10 EC faculty-wide requirement is a restricted choice of four catalogue courses. The 30 EC minor remains approved choice space. The programme is Dutch and has full-time and part-time registrations. The illustration uses the ordinary three-year full-time sequence.
progression: The catalogue and Article 7.1 require both proficiency or transition assessments and both first reading courses before poetry, epigraphy and historiography. The normal plan completes 60 EC in year one and thereby meets the positive study-advice condition for Reading 2 and the faculty-wide options. Both language research seminars and the thesis require the full first year. The regular thesis offering is in semester two, with semester one only by agreement for exceptional students. The public overview explicitly warns that its displayed older grid is for 2025–2026. No requirement from that grid is imported.
